title: Low Tide at the Basketmakers’ Feast
description: At the lowest tide of the year, the basketmakers turn their work upside down on the seawall. Each basket catches a few stars before the water returns.
alt: A basketmaker tips a wicker basket full of tiny colored stars beside three glowing baskets on a foggy, moonlit seawall.
pairing: Basketmakers’ feast × stars caught at low tide
